title: The Columnar Transposition
description: 📂 Evidence Folder #7 containing a 3-column transposition cipher.
question: Columns read vertically down: Column 1: 'TSN', Column 2: 'HIN', Column 3: 'EEG'. Reconstruct row-by-row (Row 1: T-H-E, Row 2: S-I-E, Row 3: N-N-G):
hints: Read characters horizontally across rows from Column 1, Column 2, Column 3.
Row 2: S I G -> SIG... Row 3: N.
solution: Reading row by row from the 3 columns gives 'THE SIGN'.
